verdict.rationale: Fin's own docs say tone is customizable and that Fin can be trained on your tone of voice, with marketing language about consistent, on-brand answers. Separately, a help article covers using Fin in multiple languages. Nothing shows the configured tone or brand voice holding across topics and languages, and there is no independent corroboration. Missing for 10: detailed docs on tone and brand-voice controls (the Guidance article is only a title), evidence that tone stays consistent across languages, hands-on or community corroboration of voice consistency.

support.subject: As a support leader, I control the agent's tone and brand voice, and it stays consistent across topics and languages

citations.quote: Train Fin on your knowledge, data, policies, and tone of voice. Fin will use everything it knows to deliver consistent, accurate answers
Use Fin AI Agent in multiple languages
